attackers_goals: Use an account that was possibly compromised to gain access to the network.
description: A VPN connection was attempted from a new ASN.
investigative_actions: See whether the connection was successful. Confirm that the activity is benign (e.g. the provider or location is allowed or a new user). Verify if the ASN is an approved ASN to authenticate from. Follow further actions done by the user.
name: First VPN access from ASN in organization
